name: Firebase email signup
description: Create a real Firebase account and verify a users/{uid} document is created by the backend.
steps: Enter a new email, name and password
expected: Firebase authentication succeeds, the app opens Home, and the backend creates users/{firebaseUid} and profiles/{firebaseUid}.

name: Firebase login
description: Log in with a real Firebase account.
steps: Enter a registered email and password
expected: Firebase authentication succeeds and the user remains signed in after reload.

name: Password reset
description: Use Firebase password reset email instead of a demo OTP.
expected: Firebase sends the reset email and the UI confirms it was sent.

name: Profile persistence
description: Edit profile and verify the data is persisted by the production API.
expected: Saved profile data is returned from Firestore through the Railway API.

name: Host live audio
description: Start a real Agora live room with microphone publishing.
expected: A Firestore live_rooms document is created, an Agora token is issued by the backend, and the host publishes audio into the channel.

name: Viewer joins live
description: Join a real host stream as an audience member.
expected: The viewer joins the same Agora channel and receives the host's real-time audio/video.

name: Host camera toggle
description: Enable and disable the host camera during a live room.
expected: The camera track is published and visible to subscribed viewers; turning it off disables the track.

name: R2 presigned media
description: Verify the backend can issue a short-lived R2 upload URL without exposing the R2 secret to the browser.
steps: Request a media upload from the profile/media flow
expected: The API returns a presigned URL scoped to the authenticated user's object path.
